question: In __________, the Planning Commission was set up with the Prime Minister as its Chairperson.
solution:
The correct answer is **__1950__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Planning Commission was set up on **March 15, 1950.**
 
• It is headed by **Prime Minister **of India.
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru **was the first Chairperson of the Planning Commission.
 
• It was a **non-constitutional body **formed for assessing the country’s resources and developing plans for their effective and balanced utilization. 
 
• Some key tasks includes: Formulation of Five-Year Plans, Resource Allocation, Continuous Evaluation, Policy Advisory.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Planning Commission was replaced by **NITI Aayog **on **January 1, 2015.**
 
• The council includes: 
 
 
• **Governing Council**: Includes the Prime Minister, Chief Ministers of all states, and administrators of Union Territories.
 
• **Vice-Chairperson and Members**: Appointed by the Prime Minister.
 
• **Full-Time Members**: Often experts in various fields.
 
• **Special Invitees:** Subject matter experts and eminent professionals as required for specific issues.
 
 
 
• It is formed to provide: 
 
 
• **Fostering Cooperative Federalism**: Strengthening states by participation in planning and development.
 
• **Dynamic Role**: acting as a think tank and policy advisor.
 
• **Bottom-Up Approach**: focus on collaboration at the grassroots level and local governance.
 
• **Performance Monitoring**: Detailed monitoring and evaluation of implemented policies.
 
 
 
• NITI Aayog is more functional tha Planning Commission because:
 
 
• Promotes a **bottom-up approach, **emphasizing cooperative federalism.
 
• Acts as a **dynamic think tank **that can respond quickly to changing circumstances.
 
• uses **real-time data and analytics **to assess progress and recommends corrective measures, ensuring accountability and efficiency.
 
• Encourages **innovation and entrepreneurship **through initiatives like **the Atal Innovation Mission (AIM).**
 
• Comprised of experts in various fields, facilitating more informed policy recommendations.
 
• Utilizes **modern technology and big data analytics **for policy development and monitoring.
